Container.Name: DizzyBot
Container.Overview: DizzyBot is an extensible, self-hosted Discord music bot with YouTube, SoundCloud, internet radio, and optional Spotify support. This single container includes its private Lavalink audio node; no Compose stack, second container, exposed port, or manually managed Lavalink password is required.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: discord bot lavalink youtube soundcloud spotify internet radio icecast shoutcast
Container.Requires: A Discord bot token and outbound internet access. Allow approximately 1 GB of RAM for the bundled Lavalink process.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent DizzyBot database and server settings.

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Required token from the Discord Developer Portal.

Config.Name: Spotify Client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Spotify activates automatically when both Spotify credentials are provided.

Config.Name: Spotify Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional. Spotify activates automatically when both Spotify credentials are provided.

Config.Name: Spotify Country Code
Config.Description: Two-letter country code used for Spotify metadata.

Config.Name: Radio Station Limit
Config.Description: Maximum number of saved radio stations per Discord server.

Config.Name: Allow Private Radio Streams
Config.Description: Allow saved radio URLs to reach private or local network addresses. Enable only for a trusted server.

Config.Name: Java Memory
Config.Description: Memory options for the bundled Lavalink JVM.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: UID used for the bot and Lavalink processes. The Unraid default is 99.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: GID used for the bot and Lavalink processes. The Unraid default is 100.
